dataset_split.checkpoint_selection: highest periodically observed test Spatial SRCC

router_interpretation.language_input: 4 sample-dependent image-summary tokens plus the fixed Spatial prompt tokens
router_interpretation.conclusion: The fixed prompt alone does not explain the fixed Top-2 pair. Strong differentiable diversity and flat-field trials changed probabilities but did not cross the hard Top-2 boundary without a performance cost.

phase_hardware_contract.k_space_note: At 17 um and 532 nm the sampled Nyquist angle is approximately 0.896 degrees, so the 1.0 degree setting adds essentially no extra numerical low-pass beyond sampling. The 0.75 degree real-bandlimit control reduced SRCC to 0.6218 before refinement and was not selected.
phase_hardware_contract.export: six 8-bit 1920x1200 phase-SLM BMP files, reconstructed from the canonical 478x478 planes with the audited 17 um to 8 um mapping

stages: best-checkpoint rollback and low-LR late refinement
training_recipe.readout_policy: same SpatialGridReadout architecture; separate 0.1x LR and 0.005 weight decay during micro-refinement
